scientific_justification: Operational Rapid-like filter used by the code
Eliminates beginners with chaotic play and isolates established human players
Prevents highly asymmetric games with psychological distortion or speculative play
Ensures 100% human games by excluding computer engine accounts
Eliminates non-standard piece moves and rules (e.g. Chess960 or Atomic)
Excludes premature draws/aborts (<10) and aberrant long endgames (>120)
Excludes unfinished or interrupted games marked with '*'
Excludes rage-quits and server-detected anti-cheat disqualifications
Guarantees 100% syntactical and positional integrity across the entire game
Preserves remaining time for cognitive time-trouble analysis (H2)
Prevents Lichess server evaluations and user chat from leaking into features
Complies with GDPR and academic research ethics without losing game consistency
